cost: O(n) scan, O(1) scratch; analytic scope copy O(bytes).
description: Shared bounded-error contracts and typed evidence for experimental executable approximants.
forward: Accept supported budgets and finite nonnegative metrics at or below the maximum.
Finite observations never establish an analytic bound.
inverse: All finite tuples with recorded count and maximum remain compatible.
Reject invalid errors, empty samples, zero-reference mismatches and unsupported budgets.
limitations: Caller-provided analytic bounds are not proved.
Semantic AST and general caller metric correspondence remain open.
state: (budget, errors or analytic bound, evidence scope)
